a_before_b.rationale: Understanding how supervised finetuning converts text-completion into instruction-following does not require first knowing how to distinguish information-based from behavior-based failures or when to apply RAG versus finetuning.

b_before_a.rationale: Deciding whether to apply RAG, finetuning, or both requires understanding what supervised finetuning does to a model's behavior, since finetuning is one of the options being evaluated.
